app.name: Rezzo
app.tagline: Vertical clips from podcasts and talk shows

unsaved.title: Save changes to “{{name}}”?
unsaved.body: If you don't save, your changes will be lost.

open.too-new: {{path}} was saved by a newer version of Rezzo. Update the app to open it.
open.invalid: The project {{path}} is damaged and can't be opened.

import.unreadable: {{path}} can't be read as a video.

locate.different: That's a different video. Choose the file this project was made from.

transcribe.no-audio: This video has no sound to transcribe.

episode.changed: The video at {{path}} has changed since it was imported.

transcribe.title: Transcript
transcribe.languageHelp: Pick the language people speak in this video. The transcript is always written in Latin script.
transcribe.download: The first transcription downloads speech recognition once ({{size}} GB).
transcribe.cpu: No NVIDIA graphics card found, so this runs on the processor. Expect it to take about half as long as the video.
transcribe.noAudio: This video has no sound to transcribe.

player.preparing: This video can't be played directly, so Rezzo is making a preview copy: {{percent}}%
player.failed: This video can't be played here: {{detail}}

clips.title: Clips
clips.empty: Select words in the transcript to make a clip from them.
clips.tooLong: A clip can be at most {{minutes}} minutes long.

clipEditor.name: Clip name

layoutHelp.follow: One crop that follows the speaker
layoutHelp.split: Two crops, one above the other
layoutHelp.full: The whole picture over a blurred copy of itself

clipEditor.dragHint: Drag the picture to frame it, scroll to zoom.
clipEditor.smooth: Move smoothly to the next one
clipEditor.keyframeHelp: Without keyframes the framing holds for the whole clip. Add one where the framing should change, then move the picture there.
